title: Phone Calls and Voicemail
ringkas: Menerima, menyambungkan, mengeja, dan meninggalkan pesan
goals: menjawab telepon kantor dengan sopan dan jelas
menanyakan identitas penelepon dan menyambungkan telepon: [[Who's calling, please?]], [[I'll put you through.]]
mencatat dan menyampaikan pesan: [[Can I take a message?]]
mengeja nama, email, dan nomor telepon dengan jelas
meminta pengulangan dan klarifikasi dengan sopan

lesson.text: Di telepon kita tidak bisa melihat wajah atau gerak tubuh, jadi **kejelasan** dan **kesopanan** sangat penting. Unit ini memberimu kalimat siap pakai untuk menjawab, menyambungkan, mencatat pesan, dan meninggalkan voicemail.

lesson.title: 1. Menjawab dan menelepon
table: [[Good morning, ... speaking. How can I help you?]]
[[Good morning, PT Maju Jaya, Dina speaking. How can I help you?]]
[[Could I speak to Mr. Adi, please?]]
[[May I ask who's calling?]] / [[Who's calling, please?]]
[[I'll put you through.]] / [[Hold the line, please.]]

lesson.title: Speaking, bukan I am
lesson.text: Dalam telepon, kita berkata [[This is Dina]] atau [[Dina speaking]], bukan *I am Dina*. Untuk menanyakan: [[Who's calling?]], bukan *Who are you?*.

lesson.title: 2. Situasi yang sering terjadi
table: [[I'm afraid he's not in at the moment.]] / [[He's out of the office.]]
[[She's in a meeting right now.]] / [[She's on another call.]]
[[Can I take a message?]] / [[Would you like to leave a message?]]
[[I'll ask him to call you back.]] / [[Could you call me back?]]
[[Could you hold, please?]] / [[Just a moment, please.]]
[[I think you have the wrong number.]]

items.ex: I'll put you through to Sales.
I couldn't get through to him.

lesson.title: 4. Meminta pengulangan dan klarifikasi
table: [[I'm sorry, I didn't catch that.]] / [[Could you speak up, please?]]
[[Could you repeat that, please?]] / [[Could you say that again?]]
[[Could you spell that for me?]] / [[How do you spell your surname?]]
[[Let me read that back to you.]] / [[So that's 0812-3456, correct?]]
[[Could you speak a little more slowly?]]
[[The line is breaking up.]] / [[I can't hear you very well.]]

lesson.title: 5. Mengeja dan menyebut angka
table: [[A as in Apple, B as in Boy, C as in Cat ...]]
[[Putri: P as in Paul, U as in Umbrella, T, R, I]]
[[dina.putri@abc.com = dina dot putri at abc dot com]]

lesson.title: 6. Meninggalkan voicemail
table: [[Hello, this is Dina Putri from PT Maju Jaya.]]
[[I'm calling about the delivery on Friday.]]

lines.en: Good morning, PT Maju Jaya, Dina speaking. How can I help you?
lines.id: Selamat pagi, PT Maju Jaya, Dina di sini. Ada yang bisa saya bantu?

lines.en: Good morning. Could I speak to Mr. Adi in Finance, please?
lines.id: Selamat pagi. Bisakah saya berbicara dengan Pak Adi dari Keuangan?
Boleh saya tahu siapa yang menelepon?

lines.en: This is Tom Wijaya from Sinar Supplies.
lines.id: Saya Tom Wijaya dari Sinar Supplies.

lines.en: One moment, Mr. Wijaya. I'll put you through.
I'm afraid Mr. Adi is in a meeting at the moment. Can I take a message?
lines.id: Maaf, Pak Adi sedang rapat saat ini. Boleh saya catat pesannya?

lines.en: Yes, please. Could you ask him to call me back? My number is 0812-3456-7890.
lines.id: Ya, tolong. Bisakah Anda meminta beliau menelepon balik? Nomor saya 0812-3456-7890.

lines.en: Let me read that back to you: oh-eight-one-two, three-four-five-six, seven-eight-nine-oh. Is that correct?
lines.id: Biar saya bacakan kembali: 0812-3456-7890. Apakah benar?

lines.en: You're welcome. I'll make sure he gets your message.
lines.id: Sama-sama. Saya pastikan beliau menerima pesan Anda.

lines.en: Hello, this is Tom Wijaya from Sinar Supplies. I'm calling about the invoice for May. Could you please call me back at 0812-3456-7890? Thank you, and have a good day.
lines.id: Halo, saya Tom Wijaya dari Sinar Supplies. Saya menelepon tentang faktur bulan Mei. Bisakah Anda menelepon balik di 0812-3456-7890? Terima kasih, semoga hari Anda menyenangkan.

lesson.title: Tips berbicara di telepon
lesson.text: Bicaralah **lebih pelan dan jelas**, tersenyum (suaramu terdengar lebih ramah), siapkan pena, dan **ulangi** nomor atau nama untuk memastikan. Akhiri dengan [[Thank you for calling.]]

items: Menjawab: [[... speaking. How can I help you?]]; menelepon: [[This is ... from ...]].
Menyambung: [[I'll put you through.]]; pesan: [[Can I take a message?]]
Klarifikasi: [[Could you repeat that?]] / [[Could you spell that?]] / [[Let me read that back.]]

pairs: He's not in at the moment.
